name: io.github.Red-Center-Studio/nocode-migrator
title: Bubble to Cloudflare App & Data Migrator
description: Move a Bubble® app's UI, backend, D1 data, and R2 files to your Cloudflare account. Free preview.

tools.name: nc_ping
tools.description: Works without an API key, and the free preview needs none. Checks that the migrator is reachable and returns the server name, version and time. It reports an API key as working only when one was sent with the call; otherwise it says no key was sent.

tools.name: nc_audit
tools.description: Read-only inventory of a Bubble® app before moving its data to Cloudflare D1 and R2: data types, fields, relations, option sets, record counts, types the Data API does not expose, and a risk list with the estimated workload the export would use. Nothing is written to the app. Pass app_spec (app-spec.json from the nocode-migration-audit plugin) for privacy rules and workflow counts, or editor_catalog (the Bubble MCP list_types output) when you have no app_spec. To move a whole app, start with nc_move instead: the app file, the free preview and the price need no token. A Data API token is asked for only after payment, never before; do not ask the owner for one just to audit. Returns a job_id for nc_plan.

job_id.description: A job from nc_connect: its sealed Data API token and uploaded catalog are used.

source.description: The source platform. Bubble apps only in v1.

app_base_url.description: The app's address, for example https://yourapp.bubbleapps.io or its custom domain.

data_api_token.description: A Data API token from the app's Settings > API. Needed for record counts. Never stored after the audit. Prefer nc_connect with job_id: the owner types tokens on a secure page. Only pass it here if nc_connect is not available.

version.description: Which database to count. Default live.

app_spec.description: app-spec.json from the nocode-migration-audit plugin (spec version 0.1).

editor_catalog.description: The output of the Bubble MCP list_types tool, used for the schema when there is no app_spec.

detail.description: Apps with more than 30 types get a summary of the biggest types by default. full returns everything.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

tools.name: nc_plan
tools.description: Mapping plan for a job from nc_audit: one D1 table per data type (wide types split into linked tables, lists as join tables), a SQL preview of the first three tables, slim-down suggestions (empty types, logs, chat history) and an effort tier. Nothing is created. Skip lists are decisions for the owner: pass them only after the owner agrees.

id_strategy.description: Primary keys keep the source's unique ids (the only option in v1).

primitive_lists.description: Lists of text or numbers as a JSON column (default) or a join table.

skip_types.description: Data type keys to leave out, as agreed with the owner.

skip_fields.description: Fields to leave out, as type.field.

detail.description: Plans with more than 30 tables list the biggest by default. full returns everything.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

tools.name: nc_connect
tools.description: Returns a one-time link to a page on this server where the owner types the Cloudflare token, the R2 keys and the source app's Data API token, and can upload the editor catalog file. They are checked, sealed in the job and never pass through the chat. Use it instead of putting tokens in tool calls. Give app_base_url (and version) for a new job, or job_id to add tokens to an existing one. The link works for 30 minutes. Free. With purpose export it returns the page where the owner uploads the app file instead, a single file picker and no tokens (the link works for 60 minutes); then call nc_compile_plan.

app_base_url.description: The source app's address, for a new job.

job_id.description: An existing job, to add or replace its tokens.

purpose.description: tokens (default): the page for the Cloudflare, R2 and Data API tokens. export: the page where the owner uploads the app file, so nc_compile_plan can score the move. The export link works for 60 minutes.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

tools.name: nc_compile_plan
tools.description: Reads the app file the owner uploaded (nc_connect with purpose export) and returns a move score from 0 to 100, how ready each page is, a plain-words list of what needs a person, what moves by itself, the names of the secrets to re-enter, and the price of each way to finish the move. Read only for the owner's app: nothing is changed or charged. Works on Bubble® apps. Needs the file uploaded first; the result is kept with the file and deleted with it.

job_id.description: The job_id from nc_connect. The app file must already be uploaded (nc_connect with purpose export).

detail.description: summary (default) lists the 10 pages that need the most attention. full lists every page and reusable element.

refresh.description: Compute again even if nothing changed. Normally not needed.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

tools.name: nc_changes
tools.description: Queues, lists, removes or clears changes the owner wants made during the move: rename or drop a data type or field, add a field, drop a page, change a list of choices, or swap the email provider (all automatic), or describe anything else in plain words. Names are checked against the plan from nc_compile_plan. Nothing in the owner's app changes, nothing is charged, and the move score does not change.

target.description: A page, data type or type.field, or a list of choices, as named in the plan.

params.description: For example { new_name }, { new_name, field_type (text, number, boolean, date, image, file, geographic_address) }, { add, remove } for a list of choices, { provider (brevo, sendgrid, mailgun, postmark, resend, cloudflare_email) }.

text.description: Plain words, required when kind is other (up to 2,000 characters).

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

tools.name: nc_forget
tools.description: Deletes the app file the owner uploaded and the plan built from it. Use it when the owner asks to delete their uploaded file. what=all also clears the queued changes. Safe to repeat. It does not touch tokens or billing.

what.description: export (default): the uploaded file and the plan. all: also the queued changes.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

tools.name: nc_basket
tools.description: The basket for finishing the move. list shows every add-on with its price and how it is previewed, and which add-ons and queued changes are switched on. switch turns one on or off (an add-on id such as dark_mode, or a change_id such as chg_01). Only what is switched on is charged, once, when the move is finalised; anything switched off leaves nothing in the owner's app. Only add-ons that are on sale are listed, and an add-on that needs setup (an email provider key, an admin, your own API key) says so in its needs text: tell the owner. Nothing is charged by this tool.

action.description: list, switch one item on or off, or reset every switch to its starting position (add-ons off, queued changes on).

item.description: For switch: an add-on id from list, or a change_id from nc_changes.

on.description: For switch: true to include it, false to leave it out.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

tools.name: nc_finalise_quote
tools.description: Shows exactly what finalising this app costs: the tier for its page count (the matching data move is included), the 20% extra-app discount (never more than the app's build cost) when this account finalised another app in the last 12 months, each add-on and change switched on in nc_basket, bundles, and the total in USD, with, for key holders, the prepaid balance and whether it covers it. Nothing is charged by this tool. It also states the daily upload allowance (and for key holders, uploads_left_today). You pay once by card at Stripe checkout (the Finalise button on the preview page), or, with an App Mover key that holds credits, from those credits. A part that fails its automatic check is refunded; for the refund policy, ask for a full refund before the first page of the paid build is built, 50% after the build starts, within 30 days. Paying starts the full build straight away; the Cloudflare and R2 details are asked right after payment and never block it. Pages still under the pass mark get a retry round from a stronger model.

job_id.description: The job_id from nc_connect. The app file must already be uploaded and planned.

mode.description: automatic (default): every page rebuilt and deployed. developer: the briefs and the generated backend only, for the owner's own AI assistant to build the pages.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

tools.name: nc_schema
tools.description: Generates numbered D1 migration SQL files and a Drizzle schema from the agreed plan (nc_plan), and writes them to the customer's R2 under nc/<job>/schema/. With apply: true it creates the D1 database in the customer's account and runs the migrations. Safe to repeat: every statement is idempotent. Run nc_plan first and agree its skip list with the owner. Paid: needs a pass for the app, or the free trial for plans up to 1,000 records.

r2_bucket.description: An R2 bucket in that account, for staging and schema files.

apply.description: Create the database and run the migrations. Default false: only generate the files.

max_statements.description: Statements to run per call when applying. Default 100.

go_ahead.description: Set true only when a charge applies, once the owner has seen the estimate and agreed to it. Not needed under the free trial or a pass that already covers the app. Needed again after a pass has expired.

upgrade.description: Set true to pay the difference to the next pass that fits, only when the app is past its pass's (or free trial's) record or file limit.

tools.name: nc_export
tools.description: Pages through the source app's records (read only) into NDJSON objects in the customer's R2 bucket. Resumable: progress is saved after every page, so a stopped run continues where it stopped. Each call does a bounded slice and returns status partial until every type is done; call it again. Pass since for a delta run that exports only records modified after that time. Paid: needs a pass for the app, or the free trial for plans up to 1,000 records.

types.description: Data type keys to export. Default: every type not skipped in the plan.

since.description: ISO date. Only records modified after it (a delta run). Starts a new run once the previous one is done.

max_requests_per_minute.description: Throttle for the source app. Default 60.

max_pages.description: Pages of up to 100 records per call. Default 20.

reexport.description: Export everything again even though a finished run exists.

data_api_token.description: The source app's Data API token. Needed on the first call; sealed in the job. Prefer nc_connect with job_id: the owner types tokens on a secure page. Only pass it here if nc_connect is not available.

tools.name: nc_load
tools.description: Loads the staged records into the customer's D1 database by upsert on id. A second run changes zero rows. References to records that do not exist are set to null and logged (orphans), never dropped silently. Each call does a bounded slice and returns status partial until done. truncate_first empties the tables first and needs confirm_overwrite: true. Paid: needs a pass for the app, or the free trial for plans up to 1,000 records.

mode.description: Upsert by id (the only mode in v1).

truncate_first.description: Empty the target tables before loading. Needs confirm_overwrite.

confirm_overwrite.description: Confirms that existing rows in the target may be overwritten or removed.

reprocess.description: Run every staged object again, for example after a schema change. Rows that already match change nothing.

tools.name: nc_files
tools.description: Copies every file and image the loaded data points at from the source's storage into the customer's R2 bucket, stored under its content hash (the same file is stored once). Records old URL to new key in the file_map table, fills each file field's key column, and keeps the old URL in its legacy column. Links inside text, rich text and JSON are copied too, and replaced by the app's file route (a list of files holds bare keys); the originals are backed up in text_url_backup (rewrite_text: false turns the replacing off). Every link ends copied or listed as failed with its reason, and the step is not done while any link to the old storage has no outcome. Only the source platform's own storage is copied unless allow_hosts adds more. Resumable: each call does a bounded batch and returns status partial until done. Paid: needs a pass for the app, or the free trial for plans up to 1,000 records.

bucket.description: R2 bucket for the files. Default: the staging bucket.

rewrite.description: Fill the key columns once a file is copied. Default true.

rewrite_text.description: Replace links inside text values with url_prefix plus the new key (a list of files gets the bare key). Originals go to text_url_backup. Default true.

url_prefix.description: Prefix for rewritten text links. Default /api/files/ (the generated app's file route).

allow_hosts.description: Extra hosts to copy from, for example images.example.com. Links to other hosts are listed, not copied.

retry_failed.description: Try again the files that failed or were skipped earlier.

max_bytes.description: Largest file to copy. Default 50 MB.

Passwords are not migrated: Bubble® does not export password hashes, so every user signs in with a magic link or sets a new password by email. Returns counts and an announcement template. Rules it cannot translate with certainty are listed as MANUAL with their original text, never guessed. Reads the rules saved by nc_audit when it was given an app_spec; pass app_spec here to use a newer one. Paid: needs a pass for the app, or the free trial for plans up to 1,000 records.

tools.name: nc_verify
tools.description: Checks the loaded data and says pass or fail: row counts per type against the source's count now, a checksum sample (default 500 records per type, sha256 of the canonical JSON of the mapped columns, read back from D1), broken foreign keys, and that every copied file exists in R2. Writes verification.md to the customer's R2. Reads the source and the target; changes nothing. Each call does a bounded part and returns partial until done. nc_cutover refuses to run unless the last verification passed and nothing changed after it. Paid: needs a pass for the app, or the free trial for plans up to 1,000 records.

sample.description: Records to checksum per type. Default 500.

types.description: Data type keys to verify. Default: all.

accept_unmapped_files.description: Accept that some rows keep a source file URL with no copy (links to other hosts, files that could not be copied). Without it they fail the verification.

skip_source.description: Do not count the source's records (no token). Counts are then compared with what the export reported.

restart.description: Start a new verification instead of continuing the open one.

tools.name: nc_redirects
tools.description: Builds redirects.json (301s from old Bubble® paths and query forms to the new routes), a redirects.ts module, an _redirects file, legacy-urls.json and legacy-redirects.ts (saved into legacy_parity for compilation), and a curl script that tests every URL. Old URLs come from sitemap_url, url_list, gsc_urls, or wayback: true; compiled route patterns (path_patterns) and legacy slug matching run automatically on url_list as well as gsc_urls. A URL whose route or query filter still answers 200 is listed as unchanged; a URL it cannot place is listed as unmapped with the reason, never guessed. Give new routes with page_routes, for example { "listing_detail": "/rooms/:slug" }. Paid: needs a pass for the app, or the free trial for plans up to 1,000 records.

sitemap_url.description: The old app's sitemap.xml (a sitemap index is followed).

replace.description: Start the job's stored legacy URL map again from this call alone. Without it the URLs of this call are added to what earlier calls recorded.

gsc_urls.description: Search Console top pages URL list (old indexed URLs).

wayback.description: Query Wayback CDX for historical 200 URLs on the app's domain.

path_patterns.description: Multi-segment path to query param mapping by route, for example { "/directory": ["trade", "loc"] }.

page_routes.description: Old page key to its new route. A route with :slug or :id takes one thing, for example /rooms/:slug.

page_types.description: Old page key to the data type it shows, when the name does not say.

id_slug_map.description: { type: { bubble id: slug } }. Default: read from the loaded slug columns.

tools.name: nc_cutover
tools.description: Refuses to run unless the last nc_verify passed and nothing was exported, loaded, copied or imported after it. Then returns the exact steps: freeze the old app, the final delta (nc_export with since, nc_load, nc_files, nc_users, nc_verify again), publish the redirects, the DNS change to make in Cloudflare, the email to send, what to watch, and the rollback. It never changes DNS or the old app. Call it again with complete: true and confirm_cutover: true after the move to record it and delete every credential held for the job. Paid: needs a pass for the app, or the free trial for plans up to 1,000 records.

domain.description: The address users visit, for example www.example.com. Required when the old app is on a bubbleapps.io address.

complete.description: Record that the move is done.

confirm_cutover.description: Needed with complete: confirms DNS has moved and credentials may be deleted.

r2_bucket.description: An R2 bucket in that account, for staging and schema files.

r2_access_key_id.description: Access key id of an R2 API token that can read and write that bucket. Prefer nc_connect with job_id: the owner types tokens on a secure page. Only pass it here if nc_connect is not available.

r2_secret_access_key.description: Its secret. Sealed in the job, deleted when it ends. Prefer nc_connect with job_id: the owner types tokens on a secure page. Only pass it here if nc_connect is not available.

go_ahead.description: Set true only when a charge applies, once the owner has seen the estimate and agreed to it. Not needed under the free trial or a pass that already covers the app. Needed again after a pass has expired.

upgrade.description: Set true to pay the difference to the next pass that fits, only when the app is past its pass's (or free trial's) record or file limit.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

tools.name: nc_account
tools.description: Free, and works without an API key: with no key it says what is free, what the free trial covers and what each pass costs; with a key it shows the credit balance, the passes paid for (which app, until when, record and file limits), recent credit changes, usage in the last 30 days and where to add credits.

tools.name: nc_preview
tools.description: Free 10-page interactive preview (core routes first); full site and add-ons unlock at checkout. Up to 10 pages (index plus primary navigation routes by default, or pages the owner picks) are rebuilt from the uploaded app file as React pages on sample data, then checked and scored automatically. Free, up to 5 previews per app. Nothing in the owner's app changes and nothing is charged. Typically takes about 3 minutes until the first page shows and about 7 minutes for all 10 pages (recorded runs), so call nc_preview_status every minute or so to follow it. Asking again for the same job returns the build that is already running.

job_id.description: The job_id from nc_connect. The app file must already be uploaded and planned (nc_compile_plan).

pages.description: Names of up to 10 pages, as listed by nc_compile_plan with detail full. Leave out to compile the 10 highest-priority core routes first.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

tools.name: nc_preview_status
tools.description: Shows how the free preview is going: each page's state, its automatic score (visible text, working buttons, data fields, phone width), what it cost, and when the preview is deleted. Read only.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

tools.name: nc_move
tools.description: Moves a Bubble® app to the owner's own Cloudflare account in order: app file, free preview, price and payment, Cloudflare token (Bubble Data API key optional, only if you want existing records moved; structure, pages, and option sets move without it and it is addable later), deploy and go-live. Start with no arguments or pass job_id. Answers have say, do (next step and link) and then; tell the owner do in plain words and call again when done or told. Keys go only on the secure page, never in chat. After upload, call nc_move again to start the free preview. Uploads: 6/day per network, up to 20 while an app has free previews (step shows count left, resets midnight UTC). Payment: Pay once by card. If a part of your move cannot be completed, that part is refunded. Without an App Mover key, the owner pays by card at Stripe checkout (Finalise on preview) and confirm_price_usd only confirms the total; a key with credits pays from balance. Pass include: "checklist" or "full". Tell the owner honestly that visual workflows and plugins may need small touch-ups.

job_id.description: Carry on with this move (the job_id from the first call).

app_base_url.description: Optional. The app's address, for example https://yourapp.bubbleapps.io. Left out, it is read from the app file.

include.description: Make the answer longer: checklist adds every step, full adds every detail.

version.description: Which database to read when starting. Default live.

add_ons.description: Extras to switch on (their ids from the list shown at the choose-extras step).

confirm_add_ons.description: The owner has chosen their extras (or none) and is ready to see the exact price.

confirm_price_usd.description: The exact total in USD, as shown, once the owner has agreed to it. If the total changed since, the call says so and charges nothing. With no App Mover key it only confirms the total: card payment is the Finalise button on the preview page. With a key that holds credits, the total is taken from them.

skip_data.description: Move the app without copying records, files, or users from Bubble (for example on a Bubble plan without the Data API, or a never-launched app). Records the owner's agreement. Database structure, privacy rules, and option sets still move from the .bubble file.

preview_pages.description: Optional. The pages (by name, as nc_compile_plan lists them) the owner wants in the free preview, up to 10, instead of the automatic pick. Used when the preview is queued. Left out, the pages that do the most (forms, saved data, pages opened from email and text links) are picked, and the answer says which and why.

preview_add_ons.description: Extras whose demo is built by the model from the preview pages: mobile, ai_assistant, or the id of a described change. Each extra can be tried twice and an app six times in all; the tries are free.

note.description: A few words: what is not right on that page.

rebuild_pages.description: Pages that are not right, each with a short note that goes to the builder as extra instructions. Notes made before the full build are used when it starts; notes on the built pages cause up to 2 rebuilds per page, free.

pages_ok.description: The owner has looked at the built pages and wants to go on (asked only when the server is set to stop for a look).

domain.description: The owner's domain for going live, for example example.com (with go_live_action domain).

sitemap_url.description: The old app's sitemap, for the redirect list at the go-live step. Default: the app's own /sitemap.xml.

go_live_action.description: One step of the go-live wizard, as offered in result.go_live.actions: domain (with domain, and subdomain: true for one like app.example.com), free (the app's own address, live at once), connect, move_dns, nameservers_done, check, retry (after the token is updated), back (change domain), not_yet, switch_back (within 30 days, ask the owner first), add_domain.

subdomain.description: With go_live_action domain: the owner wants a subdomain such as app.example.com.

confirm_go_live.description: The owner made the address switch by hand, without the wizard. Records the go-live.

close_job.description: After go-live: delete the tokens saved for this job and close it.

new_link.description: Make a fresh secure link even if the last one is still valid (for example when it was lost).

complete_pages.description: For a built app whose pages still miss texts, buttons, fields or popup texts and whose free rebuilds are used up: true for every built page under the pass mark, or a list of page names. Adds the missing parts with no AI model call and no rebuild used (the 2 free rebuilds per page are untouched), keeps the change only when the page's score is not worse, then the app on Cloudflare is updated by itself (once an hour at most). Free.

refresh.description: For an app that is already live: update it to the latest App Mover fixes. Free, and only when a newer version exists (the answer says so in update_available). The pages are exported again with the current code and the backend is built again with the current compiler, then both are put on the owner's Cloudflare account. Data, keys, page content and charges are not touched. Once an hour at most.

retry_now.description: Studio use: try a step now that is waiting for its next automatic retry. Never needed by the owner: problems on our side are retried by themselves.

app_spec.description: app-spec.json from the audit plugin, instead of uploading the catalog.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.
